definitions.full: H152. Adrammelek אַדְרַמֶּ֫לֶךְ proper name, masculine ( Adar is prince , Assyrian Adar-malik (?) see KAT 2284 , cf, ABK 140 ; or A. is Counsellor, Decider , compare Dl K 52 f ; otherwise Sayce Rel. Babylonian 7; on Babylonian god Adar see Schr KSGW 1880, 19 f Dl K 52 f , but Sayce Rel , Babylonian 151 f; Jen Ko 457 f and others read Assyrian name Ninib ; on Carthaginian יתנאדר see Bae Rel. 54 ) 1 a god of Sepharvaim 2Kin 17:31 . 2 parricidal son of Sennacherib 2Kin 19:37 ; Isa 37:38 . אֲדֹרָם see אדנירם below אדון . above אֲדַרְכּוֺן see דרכמון . אֶדְרְעִי see דרע .
